spells.name: Resistance
spells.summary: A willing creature adds a d4 to one saving throw.
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.summary: Stabilize a creature that is at 0 hit points.
spells.description:
Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn’t dead. The creature becomes Stable.
Cantrip Upgrade. The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).

spells.name: Bane
spells.summary: Up to three creatures that fail a save subtract a d4 from attacks and saves.
spells.description:
Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Bless
spells.summary: Up to three allies add a d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.
spells.description:
You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Ceremony
spells.summary: An hour-long ritual that grants a minor blessing.

spells.name: Command
spells.summary: Give a one-word order; the target obeys on its next turn unless it saves.

spells.name: Compelled Duel
spells.summary: Draw a creature into fighting you instead of others.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.summary: A touched creature regains 2d8 plus your spellcasting modifier in hit points.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.summary: Sense aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead nearby.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.summary: Sense the presence of magic within 30 feet.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.summary: Sense poisons, poisonous creatures and contagions within 30 feet.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.summary: Your weapon hits deal extra radiant damage for a minute.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.summary: Right after a melee hit, add radiant damage; more with a higher slot.
spells.description:
The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.summary: A creature is immune to fear and gains temporary hit points each turn.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.summary: Mark a creature: your weapon hits against it deal extra damage and you can track it.
spells.description:
You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find it.
If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3–4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good

components.materialText: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

spells.summary: A touched creature is shielded from aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead.
spells.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can’t be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.summary: Remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink nearby.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.summary: Your next hit adds fire damage and sets the target burning.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.summary: A creature you choose gets +2 to Armor Class.

spells.name: Thunderous Smite
spells.summary: Your next hit adds thunder damage and can shove the target.

spells.name: Wardaway
spells.summary: Blast a creature with force damage unless it makes its save.

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.summary: Your next hit adds necrotic damage; the target saves against the effect.

spells.name: Aid
spells.summary: Up to three creatures gain +5 maximum and current hit points.

spells.name: Consecration
spells.summary: Fill the area around you with radiant power that lingers.

spells.name: Dueling Ground
spells.summary: A ritual that marks out an area for a duel.

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.summary: Call a loyal otherworldly steed that fights beside you.
spells.description:
You summon an otherworldly being that appears as a loyal steed in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. This creature uses the Otherworldly Steed stat block. If you already have a steed from this spell, the steed is replaced by the new one.
The steed resembles a Large, rideable animal of your choice, such as a horse, a camel, a dire wolf, or an elk. Whenever you cast the spell, choose the steed’s creature type—Celestial, Fey, or Fiend—which determines certain traits in the stat block.
Combat. The steed is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count, and it functions as a controlled mount while you ride it (as defined in the rules on mounted combat). If you have the Incapacitated condition, the steed takes its turn immediately after yours and acts independently, focusing on protecting you.
Disappearance of the Steed. The steed disappears if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if you die. When it disappears, it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying. If you cast this spell again, you decide whether you summon the steed that disappeared or a different one.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.
Otherworldly Steed
Large Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (Your Choice), Neutral
AC 10 + 1 per spell level
HP 5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the spell’s level)
Speed 60 ft., Fly 60 ft. (requires level 4+ spell)
 | | Mod | Save
STR | 18 | +4 | +4
DEX | 12 | +1 | +1
CON | 14 | +2 | +2
 | | Mod | Save
INT | 6 | 2 | 2
WIS | 12 | +1 | +1
CHA | 8 | 1 | 1
Senses Passive Perception 11
Languages Telepathy 1 mile (works only with you)
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Life Bond. When you regain Hit Points from a level 1+ spell, the steed regains the same number of Hit Points if you’re within 5 feet of it.
Actions
Otherworldly Slam. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 plus the spell’s level of Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.
Bonus Actions
Fell Glare (Fiend Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, one creature within 60 feet the steed can see. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.
Fey Step (Fey Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). The steed teleports, along with its rider, to an unoccupied space of your choice up to 60 feet away from itself.
Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). One creature within 5 feet of the steed regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus the spell’s level.

spells.name: Gentle Repose

components.materialText: 2 Copper Pieces, which the spell consumes

spells.summary: Keep a corpse from decaying or rising as undead.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.summary: A humanoid that fails its save is paralyzed; it can retry each turn.
spells.description:
Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.summary: End one condition on a touched creature: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.
spells.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.summary: Sense the direction of a familiar object within 1,000 feet.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.summary: A nonmagical weapon becomes magical with a bonus to hit and damage.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.summary: Teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see.
spells.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Pinky Swear
spells.summary: A promise-binding spell. Details not read: check the spell before relying on it.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.summary: Up to five creatures regain hit points and gain the benefit of a short rest.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.summary: End poison on a creature and protect it from poison for an hour.

spells.name: Searing Orb
spells.summary: A burst of radiant damage around a point; creatures in it can save.

spells.name: Shining Smite
spells.summary: Your hits deal extra radiant damage while the spell lasts.

spells.name: Warding Bond

components.materialText: a pair of platinum rings worth 50+ GP each, which you and the target must wear for the duration

spells.summary: Link to a willing creature: it is protected, and you share its harm.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.summary: Creatures in a sphere cannot knowingly lie.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.summary: Touch a creature and spend points from your healing pool to restore its hit points.
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and restore a number of HP to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.summary: Swear a vow against a creature within 30 feet to favour your attacks against it. Costs a Channel Divinity use.
features.description:
When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 30 ft. You have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. 
If the creature drops to 0 HP, you can transfer the vow to a different creature within 30 ft.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.summary: Sense celestials, fiends and undead within 60 feet for 10 minutes. Costs a Channel Divinity use.
features.description: For the next 10 min. or until you have the Incapacitated condition, you know the location of any Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 60 ft., and you know its creature type. In the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place/object that has been consecrated or desecrated, as with the Hallow spell.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.summary: Replace one attack with a breath of acid in a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line.
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one attack with a breath weapon that is a 15-ft. Cone or a 30-ft. Line that’s 5 ft. wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature must make a DC 15 Dex. saving throw taking 2d10 Acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a success.

features.name: Draconic Flight
features.summary: Sprout spectral wings and fly for 10 minutes.
features.description: Once per Long Rest, you gain temporary flight for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

weapons.name: The Arbiter’s Ward

properties.name: Heavy
properties.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it’s a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn’t at least 13 or if it’s a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn’t at least 13.

properties.name: Reach
properties.text: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

properties.name: Two-Handed
properties.text: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

mastery.name: Cleave
mastery.text: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

weapons.description:
This halberd is made of a patterned steel, with a haft of reddish bronzewood. The swirling pattern on the axe head seems to glimmer in the sunlight.
 This item has 6 charges. You can take the Magic action and expend 1 charge to cast the Protection from Evil and Good spell. You must Concentrate on the spell like normal.
 Once the last charge has been expended, the halberd ceases to be magical. It can be re-enchanted with the Protection from Evil and Good spell at a lower cost than is usual for crafting magical items.
 Protection from Evil and Good
Level 1 Abjuration
Casting Time: Action
Range: Touch
Components: V, S, M (a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)
Duration: Concentration up to 10 minutes
Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits.
Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.
The target also can’t be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them.
If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

properties.name: Ammunition
properties.text: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon’s range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

properties.name: Heavy
properties.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it’s a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn’t at least 13 or if it’s a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn’t at least 13.

properties.name: Loading
properties.text: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

properties.name: Range
properties.text: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon’s normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon’s long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can’t attack a target beyond the long range.

properties.name: Two-Handed
properties.text: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

mastery.name: Push
mastery.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

properties.name: Heavy
properties.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it’s a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn’t at least 13 or if it’s a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn’t at least 13.

properties.name: Reach
properties.text: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

properties.name: Two-Handed
properties.text: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

mastery.name: Cleave
mastery.text: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

properties.name: Versatile
properties.text: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack. Two-handed damage: 1d10.

mastery.name: Push
mastery.text: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

traits.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
traits.summary: Bane, Hunter’s Mark, Hold Person and Misty Step are always prepared and do not count against your limit. More follow at levels 9, 13 and 17.
traits.text:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Vengeance Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
Oath of Vengeance Spells
Paladin Level | Spells
3 | Bane, Hunter’s Mark
5 | Hold Person, Misty Step
9 | Haste, Protection from Energy
13 | Banishment, Dimension Door
17 | Hold Monster, Scrying

traits.name: Vow of Enmity
traits.summary: With the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity use to gain Advantage against one creature for a minute. The vow moves to a new target if the first drops.
traits.text:
When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.
If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can transfer the vow to a different creature within 30 feet of yourself (no action required).

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.summary: Your dragon ancestor is Black, so your Breath Weapon and your damage resistance are acid.
traits.text: You have a Black Dragon ancestor.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.summary: Replace one attack with a cone or line of acid. Dexterity save for half. You can do it as many times as your proficiency bonus before a long rest.
traits.text:
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 Acid damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).
You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.summary: You take half damage from acid.
traits.text: You have resistance to Acid damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: You see in dim light as if it were bright, and in darkness as if it were dim, out to 60 feet.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.summary: Once per long rest, spectral wings give you a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes.
traits.text: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Languages
traits.summary: You speak, read and write Common, Draconic and Orc.
traits.text:
Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table. Knowledge of a language means your character can communicate in it, read it, and write it. Your class and other features might also give you languages.
Languages you know from your species: Common, Draconic, Orc.

traits.name: Savage Attacker
traits.summary: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, roll its damage dice twice and use either result.
traits.text: You’ve trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

traits.name: Blessed Warrior
traits.summary: Two Cleric cantrips count as Paladin spells for you, cast with Charisma. You can swap one each time you gain a Paladin level.
traits.text: You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice. The chosen cantrips count as Paladin spells for you, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip.

traits.name: Weapon Mastery
traits.summary: Use the mastery property of two kinds of weapon you are proficient with. You can change the kinds after a long rest.
traits.text:
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.
Chosen on the sheet (as of the last import): Graze (Greatsword), Cleave (Halberd).

traits.name: Dark Bargain
traits.summary: A bargain taken at the GM’s discretion; the GM decides what it does.
traits.text: At your GM's discretion, you can take a Dark Bargain.

traits.name: Initiate a Circle Spell
traits.summary: Start a Circle casting with secondary casters. You must keep Concentration on the spell until the casting is complete.
traits.text: You take a Magic action to initiate casting a Circle spell. When you do so, choose which Circle casting option you’re using for this casting; you must also meet any of the other requirements described in that option’s text. Until the Circle spell’s casting is complete, you must maintain Concentration on the spell.

traits.name: Circle Spell: Augment
traits.summary: A spell with range of at least 5 ft. reaches 1,000 ft. further for each secondary caster, up to a mile.
traits.text: When you cast a spell with a range of at least 5 ft., you can increase the range of the spell by 1,000 ft. per secondary caster contributing to the spell, up to a max of a 1-mile increase.

traits.name: Circle Spell: Distribute
traits.summary: You and the secondary casters can all keep Concentration on one spell; it lasts while any one of you does.
traits.text: When you cast a spell that requires Concentration, you can distribute the mental load of the spell among you and the secondary casters. Once the casting is complete, you and all secondary casters can maintain Concentration on this spell. As long as at least one caster who contributed to the spell maintains this Concentration, the spell’s effects remain active.

traits.name: Circle Spell: Expand
traits.summary: One dimension of an area grows by 10 ft. per secondary caster, and each of them spends a spell slot.
traits.text:
When you cast a spell that creates an area of effect, you can increase one dimension of the spell’s area of effect for this casting by 10 ft. per secondary caster contributing to the spell. 
Each secondary caster contributing to the spell must expend a spell slot (no action required). If the spell fails, these spell slots aren’t expended.

traits.name: Circle Spell: Prolong
traits.summary: A spell lasting 1 minute or more runs longer for each secondary caster, and each of them spends a spell slot.
traits.text:
When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 min or longer, you can increase the duration of the spell depending on the number of secondary casters contributing to the spell.
Each secondary caster contributing to the spell must expend a spell slot (no action required). If the spell fails, these spell slots aren’t expended.

traits.name: Circle Spell: Safeguard
traits.summary: Carve a safe zone of 3 + the number of secondary casters 5-ft. Cubes out of an area spell.
traits.text:
When you cast a spell that creates an area of effect, you can carve out a safe zone within that area of effect that is unaffected by the spell for its duration. This safe zone consists of a number of 5-ft. Cubes equal to 3 + the number of secondary casters contributing to the spell (min of 1 Cube). You can arrange the Cubes as you like, but each Cube must be contiguous with at least one other Cube.
If the spell’s area of effect can be moved, the safe zone moves with it.

traits.name: Circle Spell: Supplant
traits.summary: Cut the cost of a consumed Material component by 50 GP per secondary caster, who each spend a slot of the spell’s level or higher.
traits.text:
When you cast a spell that requires at least one Material component with a specified cost that is consumed by the spell, you can reduce the min cost of one such Material component by 50 GP per each secondary caster contributing to the spell.
Each secondary caster contributing to the spell must expend a spell slot of a level greater than or equal to the spell’s level (no action required). If the spell fails, these spell slots aren’t expended.

traits.name: Undead Steed: Ghostly Stride
traits.summary: An Undead Find Steed moves you both through creatures and objects this turn. Recharges on a long rest.
traits.text:
In addition to the benefits of the Paladin’s Faithful Steed feature, when you cast Find Steed, the Otherworldly Steed can be Undead. An Undead steed deals Necrotic damage with its Otherworldly Slam action and has this Bonus Action:
Ghostly Stride (Undead Only; Recharges After a Long Rest). The steed and its rider can move through other creatures and objects this turn as if they were Difficult Terrain. Both steed and rider take 5 (1d10) Force damage if they end their turn inside an object.
